REFINEMENT_of_F26.F26_as_stated: The product with the richest decision-support layer has the poorest ranking layer — measured across Booking.com (0 decision surfaces), Expedia (0) and Google Travel (4). Framed as a property of Google.
REFINEMENT_of_F26.what_Kayak_shows: Kayak also has a decision layer: Explore, Best time to travel, Price alerts, price prediction, flexible dates, and a standalone Flight Tracker. It is not a Google idiosyncrasy.
REFINEMENT_of_F26.the_refined_finding: Decision-support tracks BUSINESS MODEL, not company. The two products that do NOT complete the transaction — Google Travel and Kayak, both of which hand off — have built rich decision layers. The two that DO complete it — Booking.com and Expedia — have none, and instead deploy price anchoring and urgency at the point of choice.
REFINEMENT_of_F26.why_the_refinement_is_stronger: As stated, F-26 was a fact about one company and easy to dismiss. As refined, it is a structural claim with a mechanism: a product that earns on the transaction is incentivised to close, and a product that earns on the referral is incentivised to be TRUSTED, because trust is what brings the traveller back to click through again.
REFINEMENT_of_F26.what_would_falsify_it: A transactional competitor with a genuine decision layer, or a meta-search without one. Skyscanner (5), Hopper (6), Trainline (10), Rome2Rio (12) all test it directly and none is captured yet.

finding_F36_FLIGHT_TRACKER.claim: Kayak ships a standalone Flight Tracker at /tracker — a direct analogue of a named Luma core feature.
finding_F36_FLIGHT_TRACKER.why_it_matters: Luma's Core Features list includes 'Live flight tracking'. Kayak gives it away free, unbundled from any booking, as a top-level product. Combined with Google's price tracking and price history, two of Luma's named features already exist as free-standing free tools from products that never sell the flight.
finding_F36_FLIGHT_TRACKER.not_observed: Whether the tracker requires an account, and what it does on disruption. OWED.

account_value_proposition.comparison_to_F29: Kayak's account offer MIXES capability (saved searches, price alerts) with commercial benefit (Private Deals). Booking.com's was purely commercial (a discount sort axis); Google hotels' was purely functional (price tracking). Kayak sits between them.

our_product_decision_required: Decision required: two of Luma's named core features — live flight tracking and price monitoring — are already free, unbundled tools from Kayak and Google. Luma cannot differentiate by having them. What does it add?

Decision required: if decision-support really tracks business model, Luma must decide which side it is on BEFORE designing the layer. It proposes to complete transactions AND be the trusted advisor. No observed competitor does both.
Decision required: what does a Luma account buy on day one — capability, commercial benefit, or both? Three competitors, three different answers.
